items.title: WSJ: Ken Paxton partied in Dubai on NYE 2024 with two indicted US fugitives
items.summary: Wall Street Journal exclusive (published Oct 13, 2026): video shows TX Senate GOP nominee Ken Paxton ringing in 2025 in Dubai with girlfriend Tracy Duhon alongside two Americans indicted months earlier on federal healthcare-fraud charges (Anosh Ahmed, Sameer Suhail) who had not returned to the US at the time. Ahmed donated $190,000 to Paxton, including $25,000 days after his indictment; both men have since returned to face charges (Ahmed in custody). Paxton aide Nick Maddux did not address the trip; Talarico responded on X: 'A party with multiple fugitives and Ken Paxton is still the sketchiest guy in the room.' A week before TX early voting begins (Oct 19); Talarico leads in recent polling.

items.title: WaPo investigation: Paxton issued AG legal opinions benefiting wealthy donors
items.summary: Washington Post investigation (published Oct 13, 2026): as TX attorney general, Paxton repeatedly wrote legal opinions favoring donors with business before his office — executives tied to a slot-machine-like gambling game gave his campaign $100,000+ while his office reviewed whether those games counted as gambling; in 2018 he issued an opinion helping a donor's concrete plant get built over Fort Worth's objections, donor gave $10,000 two months later; anesthesiologist groups gave $24,000 a month after an opinion they pushed; Texas Tech board chair donated $247,300 the day before Paxton threatened to sue the Big 12 over a Texas Tech football player. Paxton campaign offered no response; Texas Dems called it pay-to-play.
